recommendation: Keep the commit. Future regeneration of common search parameters or Library model-info artifacts should not reintroduce these names as core FHIR 6.0 resources; references to the immunization incubator IG should be maintained by that external Additional Resource IG.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core issue requesting that ImmunizationEvaluation and ImmunizationRecommendation not remain domain-specific CDS resources and that a more generic recommendation approach be pursued with Public Health and other stakeholders.
initial_application: No FHIR-14855-tagged commit was found. The later removal commit e073fb45ec6f5a738a9f674baf63406bfe90fb78 removed both resource directories, active fhir.ini entries, core resource-list entries, and the Immunization.basedOn target, and moved several narrative links to the immunization incubator Additional Resource IG.
additional_context: 2022 Public Health notes explored an ImmunizationRequest/RequestOrchestration alternative but recorded concerns; the 2023 Jira comment clarified Immunization/ImmunizationRecommendation focus on IIS representation and MedicationRequest for clinical workflow ordering. 2025 FMG Zulip discussion shows the two resources moved to an immunization incubator IG as Additional Resources, so external incubator links are intentionally retained.
reconciliation: Removed ImmunizationEvaluation and ImmunizationRecommendation from the common clinical SearchParameter base lists; removed ImmunizationEvaluation, ImmunizationRecommendation, their backbone/status model-info classes, and matching helper/conversion entries from FHIR and QUICK model-info content; synchronized embedded Library.data in the FHIR ModelInfo and FHIRHelpers Library resources.
